job.title: Asset Risk Strategy Engineer

The Port of Melbourne is Australia’s largest maritime hub for containerised, automotive and general cargo. It is a key economic asset for businesses and people across Victoria and Australia. This is an opportunity to work closely with internal and external stakeholders to strengthen risk-informed asset planning, support compliance monitoring and help shape long-term capital decisions for nationally significant port infrastructure.

  • Support risk-based asset planning, governance and investment decision-making.
  • Provide assurance and SME input to ensure compliance with internal, engineering and regulatory requirements.
  • Support Electrical and Rail compliance monitoring for major and growth projects.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, consultants and delivery teams on asset, risk and compliance matters.
  • Contribute to asset management maturity uplift and ISO 55000-aligned practices.
  • Coordinate across internal stakeholders and consultants.
About You:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience in asset management, strategy, risk or infrastructure compliance
  • Knowledge of ISO 55000 principles and asset management frameworks
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Exposure to electrical, rail or infrastructure compliance (desirable)
  • Experience with tools such as Excel, Power BI, TechnologyOne (desirable)

job.title: Senior R&D & Innovation Chemist
job.description:

Our client is an established, founder-led Australian skincare brand offering results-driven solutions in the thriving dermatological skincare sector. With international growth aspirations and a strong innovation agenda, the business is focused on building a world-class product pipeline and go-to-market execution capability.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Senior R&D & Innovation Chemist to help shape the future of evidence-based, high-performance skincare. Reporting to the Head of Research and Development, this role will lead research, formulation and product development activity across premium cosmeceutical and medical-grade skincare ranges, with a focus on clinically proven innovation, visible results and consumer-led product concepts.

This is a hands-on, commercially connected role for a highly curious formulation professional who enjoys combining scientific rigour, creativity and cross-functional collaboration to bring market-leading skincare products to life.

What you’ll be doing
  • Research skin biology, active ingredients and emerging skincare technologies to inform new product concepts and innovation opportunities.
  • Support the development of a long-range, consumer-led NPD pipeline aligned to brand strategy and commercial growth priorities.
  • Lead and support end-to-end formulation, testing, claims development and clinical validation across new and existing products.
  • Develop science-backed formulations targeting key skin concerns, incorporating clinically proven actives and advanced delivery technologies.
  • Design and oversee clinical testing protocols to validate product safety, tolerability and efficacy.
  • Prepare technical documentation, product scientific data, claims dossiers and scientific publications.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Education, Sales, Regulatory, Quality and Supply Chain teams to support successful product launches.
  • Partner with external laboratories, universities, research institutions, suppliers and industry experts to strengthen product credibility and accelerate development.
  • Support scale-up, technology transfer and manufacturing troubleshooting while maintaining quality, compliance and commercial feasibility.
  • Identify opportunities to improve formulation complexity, cost, sustainability and product performance.

About you
  • Master’s or PhD qualification in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Science or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years’ experience in cosmeceutical, skincare, personal care or related product development, ideally with clinical or medical-grade products.
  • Proven experience developing and validating skincare products with scientific or clinical substantiation.
  • Strong knowledge of dermatology, skin biology, active ingredients, cosmeceutical trends, claims substantiation and product safety standards.
  • Experience managing or supporting clinical trials, external testing or independent product validation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation and project management skills.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both scientific and commercial stakeholders.
  • A hands-on approach, high attention to detail and a passion for advancing skin science and improving visible skin health outcomes.

Why join this business?
  • Join a respected, founder-led Australian skincare brand in an exciting transformation and growth phase.
  • Play a key role in developing world-class, evidence-based performance skincare products.
  • Work closely with a collaborative, cross-functional team across R&D, Marketing, Education, Regulatory, Quality, Sales and Supply Chain.
  • Contribute to meaningful innovation, scientific claims and product launches that support brand growth in Australia and internationally.
  • Enjoy a competitive package and an inclusive, supportive workplace culture.

Apply now

If you are a hands-on R&D professional who is passionate about science-backed skincare innovation and ready to contribute to a brand with ambitious growth plans, we would love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant product development experience. If you require further information, please contact Voula Triantafillou on 0437 853 201

job.title: Senior Civil Engineer – Built Environment & Urban Growth
job.description:
If you live in Brisbane, you’ll be experiencing the constant evolution the city moves towards across residential, commercial and mixed-use development. This growth is creating exciting opportunities for experienced civil engineers who are looking to move their design expertise into design leadership and project delivery.

This is also an excellent opportunity for those based outside of Brisbane or interstate who are looking to relocate and contribute to shaping Queensland’s growing built environment.

Our client is a well-established and regarded engineering consultancy, recognised for delivering high-quality development, residential and commercial projects across the East Coast. With a strong existing stream of work and continued growth, they are seeking a Senior Civil Engineer to join their Brisbane team in a design management and project leadership capacity.

This role is ideal for an engineer who has progressed beyond purely hands-on design and is now focused on overseeing civil design delivery, coordinating teams, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across urban development projects.

The Role

As a Senior Civil Engineer, you will play a key role in the management and delivery of civil design packages across a range of urban development projects, including residential subdivisions, commercial developments, and industrial estates.

You will be involved across the full project lifecycle, from concept through to detailed design and construction documentation review, with a strong emphasis on coordinating and guiding design teams. As the senior engineer, you will ensure design outputs are delivered to a high standard, aligned with project requirements, and compliant with relevant Australian Standards and local council guidelines.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and coordinate the delivery of civil design packages for urban development projects
  • Oversee design work produced by engineers and designers using 12d, including earthworks, road design, and stormwater drainage
  • Review civil drawings, reports, and technical documentation for accuracy and compliance
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables
  • Liaise with internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders to ensure successful project outcomes
  • Assist with tender submissions, proposals, and fee estimates
  • Mentor and support graduate engineers, designers, and junior staff
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders
  • Ensure all designs comply with Australian Standards and relevant council requirements

About You

You are a technically strong civil engineer who has transitioned into, or is ready to transition into, a design management and delivery-focused role. You understand civil design principles in detail but are now more focused on coordination, oversight, and project leadership.

What the role requires:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering
  • 6–12 years of consultancy experience
  • Strong background in urban development, subdivision, and drainage projects
  • Experience overseeing design delivery teams working in 12d
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD for civil documentation review
  • Exposure to flood modelling tools such as TUFLOW or HEC-RAS is highly regarded
  • Solid understanding of SEQ council standards and Australian Design Standards
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage projects while guiding technical teams
  • RPEQ registration (or working towards it) is highly desirable

What’s on Offer
  • Work on diverse urban development projects across South East Queensland
  • Opportunity to take ownership of design delivery and project outcomes
  • Direct exposure to clients and key stakeholders
  • Strong pipeline of ongoing work in a growing market
  • Professional development and clear career progression opportunities
  • Competitive salary package based on experience

If you are a Senior Civil Engineer with strong consultancy experience and are looking to step into a design management role within a dynamic and growing environment, we would love to hear from you.
